AT&T ActiveArmor mobile security helps keep your phone and personal data safe from cyber threats. Get spam blocking, fraud detection, identity and financial protection in one powerful solution with AT&T ActiveArmor.

AT&T ActiveArmor mobile security (FREE) service includes: *
• Auto Fraud & Spam Call Blocking
• Call Routing Settings
• My Block List
• My Contacts
• Device Security Alerts
• Data Breach Alerts

*Requires compatible device/service and download of ActiveArmor app. Other terms and restr’s apply. May not detect all threats and may inadvertently block wanted calls; can adjust settings in app. Data charges may apply.

The following free features only work for AT&T wireless customers: Auto Fraud Call Blocking, Spam Call Blocking, Call Routing Settings, My Block List, My Contacts, and Caller ID.

If you upgrade to ActiveArmor Advanced Mobile Security, you get all the free features plus these additional features:**
• Caller ID
• Reverse Number Lookup
• Public Wi-Fi Protection (VPN & Wi-Fi Alerts)
• Safe Browsing/Banking/Shopping
• $1M Identity Theft Insurance
• Credit Monitoring
• Payday Loan Monitoring
• Identity Monitoring
• Social media ID Protection
• Lost Wallet Recovery
• ID Restoration
• Password Manager

**The AT&T Advanced Mobile Security subscription is $7/month per line and auto-renews unless canceled.
• To avoid being charged again, cancel at least 24 hours before your next payment date or before your current billing period ends.
• If you pay for your subscription on your AT&T wireless bill you can manage or cancel your service in the ActiveArmor app in the Settings menu > Change subscription. Or you can manage or cancel in the AT&T app (myAT&T) under “Active add-ons".
• If you pay through your Apple account: go to Settings on your iPhone > your name (Apple ID) > Subscriptions > AT&T ActiveArmor > Cancel Subscription (or Manage), then follow the prompts.
• After you cancel Advanced, you can still use the free ActiveArmor mobile security features.
• Payments are non-refundable, except as required by law. For details, visit https://www.att.com/support/article/wireless/KM1252909/

Visit www.att.com/activearmorapp for details.
Visit www.att.com/legal/terms.activeArmorMobileSecurity.html for the full AT&T ActiveArmor mobile security Terms of Service.
